newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA NOT HURRYING ON LITIMPEKS DECISION.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA NOT HURRYING ON LITIMPEKS DECISION.

text.p: Tallinna Pank said on Monday the chance of it being a strategic investor in Litimpeks was small if the Lithuanian bank wants to end talks in May.
"If Litimpeks wants to finish talks at the end of May, the investment is not probable but if they have more time there are possibilities," Targo Raus, vice-chairman, told Reuters.
Litimpeks said on Friday it was in talks with Estonia's Tallinna Pank and Poland's Kredyt Bank to find a strategic investor to buy 30 to 50 percent of a planned 60 million litas share issue.
Litimpeks said it would like to finish the talks by May 20.
"We have not made any decision yet," Raus said, adding it was also in talks with other banks.
Raus said that Tallinna Pank was not going to speed up its schedule to enter the Lithuanian market, which it plans to decide on at the end of the year, Raus said.
